We are delighted to announce the recipients of the **GIScRG Dissertation Award 2025**, following a careful review of the submitted dissertations.

## Winner

**Miaoyi Li**  
Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis, The Bartlett Faculty of the Built Environment, University College London

*“Digital Planning Support in a Data-Scarce Context by Estimating Urban Activities: A Case Study in Jaipur City, India”*

## Runner-up

**Nicholas Kinsella**  
School of Geography and Environmental Sciences, Ulster University

*“Monitoring Methane Emissions at Hassi Messaoud from 2021 to 2024 Using Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-5P: Assessing Algeria’s Progress Towards Its 2030 GHG Reduction Target”*

The winner will receive **£100 and a one-year RGS-IBG Postgraduate Fellowship**, while the runner-up will receive **£50 and a one-year RGS-IBG Postgraduate Fellowship**.

The recipients should contact **Nick Bearman** at [nick@nickbearman.com](mailto:nick@nickbearman.com) to arrange delivery of their awards.

We would like to thank the members of the award selection committee for their time and valuable contributions:

- **Professor Gary Higgs**, University of South Wales
- **Dr Ye Tian**, University College Dublin
- **Dr Yuchen Li**, University of Leeds
- **Dr Meiliu Wu**, University of Glasgow

Special thanks also go to **Dr Xiao Li of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University** for coordinating and organising the award selection process.

Congratulations to both recipients, and thank you to everyone who submitted their work. We greatly appreciate your contributions to GIScience research.
